// Positive control (#5170): a gate verb entry that declares the exit outcome without the gate-exit seam.
import { declareGateExit } from './gate-exit.cjs';
import cliExit = require('./cli-exit.cjs');

export function cmdFixtureVerb(passed: boolean): void {
  declareGateExit({ outcome: 'pass' }, 'status');
  if (!passed) cliExit.declareOutcome('FAIL');
}
